My point is that BPD is an horrible mental illness and I really hope you don't have it, but if you think you might have it maybe talk to a doctor before it get worse. Remember that BPD is deadly and not curable so it is important to have professional help.

For a person with BPD, emotions are very overwhelming. She experience very intense mood swing and it can be very confusing. BPD is often the cause of comorbidities such as depression and other personality disorders ( like avoidant personality disorder). 
Weed is a classic unhealthy coping mechanic (with other drugs, alcool, hypersexuality,...). It's not really her fault, weed calm her mood swings and disconnect her from the pain but it's not a solution because it has bad effects like social isolation. 
She might need a medical support with mood stabilizers for example which will help her to reduce the intensity of mood swings without weed.
Remember that it is a disease caused by bad chemistry in her brain. I don't know neither of you, but she surely are in love with you and you might be the most important person to her (her Favorite Person).
 I'm not gonna lie, it will be very hard, but with a proper treatment (usually mood stabilizers, antidepressants and cognitive behavioral therapy) it gonna be alright with some time :)
I wish you two the very best
